title: shellBody reads powershell -Command, pwsh -c and cmd /c bodies for every guard
notes: Follow-up from #364: running-app-guard.ts now judges the body of powershell -Command / pwsh -c / cmd /c (//c from Git Bash) on its own; the shared shellBody in hook-answer.ts does not, so test-run-guard misses pwsh -c "pnpm test" and startsClaude in src/main/actions/pane/send.ts misses powershell -Command claude. Move the unwrapping into shellBody so every guard gets it, with a test per caller.

comments.body: This card is GitHub issue #365; the PR says Closes #365. Build on #364's windowsShellBody once #364 is merged.

PR #367. Left for later: package-manager-guard.ts and worktree-guard.ts never call shellBody, so sh -c 'npm install' or pwsh -c "git worktree remove …" still gets past them. The deeper fix is partsWithFolders/simpleCommands expanding a body into its inner commands, so every guard gets it without its own recursion.
Pull request #367 opened: shellBody reads powershell -Command, pwsh -c and cmd /c bodies for every guard https://github.com/naeemba/dashboard/pull/367

Review loop: converged, ready to merge. 1 round; the one finding (nit: stale comments in test-run-guard.ts and send.ts still said only sh -c bodies are read) fixed in 87e56633, final check accepted it. No conflicts. CI passed on 87e56633.
